text: A cloud security group is stateful; a network ACL is not. What is the practical consequence?
choices: A security group permitting inbound 443 automatically permits return traffic; a network ACL requires an explicit rule for the ephemeral range in the other direction
explanation: Forgetting the return rule on a network ACL is one of the most common cloud networking faults. The two exist because they operate at different scopes and one is a defence-in-depth layer for the other.
